title: Veterans Pension Benefit Income Statement Certified by the Veteran
content:
# Benefit income statement — Veterans Pension

When monthly VA disability compensation paid to a Veterans Pension recipient for months his pension was also paid stops or changes, the veteran states in his own words the annual benefit income he receives in his own name — his Social Security, his federal civil service annuity and his VA disability compensation — and that statement is the income change report for the source that changed.

**Date of the statement.** The statement is dated as a change that began on the date the compensation award closed, or on the date of the latest compensation payment when the award has not closed.

**Ages measured to that date.** Every age the statement measures is measured to the date it carries, the day the change began, and not to the day the veteran files it.

**Amount.** The statement is an annual amount in dollars and cents, rounded to the cent.

| Compensation award | Date the change began |
|---|---|
| Closed | the date the compensation award closed |
| Not closed | the date of the latest compensation payment |

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a compensation award closed on 2025-11-30 and a statement filed on 2026-03-10 — the statement carries 2025-11-30, and an age it measures runs to 2025-11-30, not to 2026-03-10.

## The filing tool: `certify_benefit_income_d2f4edcf`

**What it does.** It files, on the veteran's Veterans Pension award, the annual benefit income the veteran certifies in his own name, as an income change report for the benefit-income source. One call adds one new income change report to the award, received that day by telephone; nothing already on the award is changed.

**Who runs it.** This is the veteran's own certification. The agent unlocks `certify_benefit_income_d2f4edcf` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the veteran — runs it in his own name. The agent does not run it on his behalf.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pension_award_id` | the reference number of the veteran's Veterans Pension award, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran | identifier |
| `change_effective_date` | the date the benefit-income change began | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time of day, no time zone |
| `annual_amount` | the certified annual benefit income, in USD | decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 is allowed when no benefit income remains |

**Return.** On success the veteran hears back one sentence of the form "Benefit income statement <reference> filed on award <award reference>: annual amount <amount> USD, change effective <date>, received <today's date> by phone." The amount is shown with 2 decimal places and the received date is the current date written YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this sentence means the statement is on file. The tool defines no other outcome.

### Illustration of the call (hypothetical values)

An award with reference PA-1001, a compensation award that closed on 2026-02-14 and a certified figure of 21450.375 would be passed as `change_effective_date` 2026-02-14 and `annual_amount` 21450.38.
